Prepared Languages and Living Voices as a core knowledge domain with connected profiles, original-language material, oral traditions and community review. Research leads remain distinct from completed histories.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: We should also include language - Odia is primary and there are many other language - we should elaborate each with their cultural hetigate and history

title: Many languages, and the people who give words a life
summary: Founder reinforced Odisha’s linguistic diversity and asked for Odia literature and prominent literary personalities. Prepared connected language and literature collections, a writer/work model and an initial research queue; other language research proceeds alongside Odia.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes:
Odisha has many languages other than Odia and we should speak about it

We should talk about Odia literature and famous personalities around that

title: Ghasi is the fuel cake, not loose straw
summary: Founder corrected the Instagram card’s material reference: ghasi is a round, flattened, approximately dosa-sized fuel cake made from cow dung and paddy straw. Preserve selected olive/straw colours; replace loose-straw imagery with the actual dried cakes and use hearth in the palette story.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: Ghasi is a round dosa size thing they make in the village - cow dunk and peddy straw

title: The colours get a home of their own
summary: Founder asked to save the corrected card and explain it on the branding page. Added the bilingual card and the laterite, sea and ghasi stories, preserving the material clarification and earlier artwork. Local candidate checked; no public release.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: save it - we can explain this in our branding page

title: Words become places to explore
summary: Returning to website work, the language and literature programme became six connected preview pages. A real palm-leaf manuscript, an Ol Chiki sample and a commemorative bust give the first stories visual anchors. The collection begins with Odia, Santali, Fakir Mohan and Six Acres and a Third, leaving room for other voices.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: Let's go back to the site work and continue on that

title: A story you can take with you
summary: Founder approved moving from connected cultural stories to a personal journey prototype. Readers can now collect a place, a taste and a reading idea, arrange days and keep their own notes without an account. Three reading trails connect landscape, language and literature. Local candidate only; the first print layout still needs native PDF review.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: Go ahead
source.context: Response to the proposed connected cultural stories followed by a personal tour-book prototype.

title: More than one way back to Odisha
summary: The Founder asked to keep moving through the list. The next planner increment lets a reader hold several possible journeys, give one a date and keep another as an idea. Earlier notes are preserved through migration and portable backups.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: Whats next in the list, keep going

title: From a reading trail to a place to begin
summary: The Founder asked to keep going. Balasore and Mayurbhanj become the next regional guides, joining real landscapes to literary lives, language, craft and food. A reader can now carry these choices into a personal journey.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: keep going

title: Ten steps from reading Odisha to carrying a journey
summary: The Founder asked for ten pending items followed by review. The next batch joins two northern landscapes, three distinct languages and two literary lives to practical access notes, a carryable offline text book and a way for readers to prepare evidence-backed corrections. Human editorial authority remains unchanged.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: Keep going - do 10 things from our pending list and then review

title: Pictures to carry, and a public door into the story
summary: The next approved batch makes discovery easier on a small screen, gives the offline book real photographs and opens a clearly public contribution path through GitHub. Two literary lives and two food stories deepen the collection. The Founder remains the final editor.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: go ahead
GitHub Issues, with submissions visible publicly

title: Walk the journey before opening the door
summary: The Founder agreed to a release-readiness pass. Walking the reader path exposed a missing flagship photograph and a new-subject contribution gap. Both were corrected, and a concrete preview with honest printing limits was prepared for human review.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: Sounds good

title: A shared design practice, an identity of our own
summary: The Founder suggested adapting lessons from Kabita Live. The resulting proposal preserves Utkal colours and identity while borrowing a disciplined approach to typography, components and review. Reference approvals remain project-specific.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: In the Kabita Live Project, we built a design system, and maybe we can adopt that here too with some changes as required.

title: One design language, many places to belong
summary: The Founder authorized a reusable Utkal Design System. The first candidate joins the existing stone, sea and hearth identity to shared type, spacing and components, with a review gallery and three real page pilots. Other projects can adopt a pinned version under their own human authority.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: That sounds good. Let's build Utkal Design System and then we can use everywhere

title: A design language learns from the places it serves
summary: The Founder asked to use the system and improve it through practice. Real destination stories, a photograph archive and a personal journey showed where a common language needs flexibility: wide pictures, readable panels, native scripts and controls that keep their meaning. Those lessons return to the reusable library.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: Let's do that and based on what we learn update the design system

title: Twenty small steps, one shared standard
summary: The Founder accepted the working design and asked for pace without losing care. Reusing the same story and visitor templates made room for three cities, three smaller places, three languages and a poet. Planner recovery and easier contributions grew alongside the collection. The batch makes progress visible while leaving human editorial and publication authority intact.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: All in the right direction - I will make changes - but for now, I am good with what we have.
We have millions of things to do...we need to speed up and yet hold the standard and quality.

title: A photograph becomes a starting point
summary: The next step connected the growing collection: seven photographic destination doors, familiar Odia names, links between stories and three starting collections. Visitors can make a journey their own while keeping earlier plans intact. The same design foundations carry each step.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: OK, lets go

title: From interesting to useful
summary: The Founder noted that inner pages still needed work and asked to keep moving. The next batch paired targeted layout corrections with food, activity and stay-area entry points, then added personal preparation reminders that travel with a saved journey. Broader visual refinement stays visible in the backlog.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: Inner Page layout has issues - but maybe we are not full built them too
Let's go to the next set of backlogs

title: Let the picture help the words; let the film help the song
summary: Ahimanikya carried a thought from his Kabita Live discussions into Utkal: design the image and the reading, the film and the listening, as a connected experience. A photograph is not always enough to explain a subject. AI imagery can give supported ideas a clearer visual form, with interpretation distinct from evidence.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: A picture makes the text more readable, and a video makes the music more listenable

title: Give someone a reason to go
summary: The Founder sharpened the purpose of Utkal’s stories: make them worth reading, worth sharing with friends and worth planning a visit around. The aim is for someone to imagine an experience they would value, with evidence and practical detail supporting the desire.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: Worth reading, worth sharing with friends, and worth planning a visit. Create that desire why I should visit this place

title: Three subjects, three ways to care
summary: The Founder’s wish for stories worth reading, sharing and visiting became three local reference experiences. Chilika pairs poetry with wetland imagery; Chhena Poda opens a conversation with a maker; Gopinath Mohanty leads into a book. Their common patterns return to the Utkal Design System.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: Sounds good, let's go

title: A page needs a thread
summary: The Founder found the first storytelling reference pages jumpy and disorganised. The next revision removed repeated openings and oversized callouts, aligned the visual chapters and treated supplementary material as optional. Passing component tests had not established the quality of the whole reading experience.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: Things are very jumpy and feel disorganized - flow is missing

title: Looking at the page changed the verdict
summary: The Founder challenged whether the flow revision had fixed the experience. A browser audit found a concrete 32-pixel text-column failure and several composition conflicts. The assistant recorded a failed review and returned the reference work to draft instead of treating passing technical checks as visual approval.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: I am not it has fixed things - do a visual audit using browser skill

title: Repair the cause, then read the page
summary: Following the Founder’s approval, the audit defects were repaired at their source: remove the hidden number column, give one composition ownership of reading widths, keep one ending, and reduce the phone’s introductory controls. The historical failed review remains alongside measured repair evidence.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: Ok let's fix it

title: Choose the experience before building more
summary: After technical repairs, the Founder still did not like the page design. The work moved from patching the current composition to comparing three complete page experiences with the same story and imagery. Selection remains a human decision before integration.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: To be honest - I am not sure I like page design - maybe we need mock a few options and then apply

title: A magazine to invite a visit
summary: The Founder chose the visual magazine direction. Chilika now leads through a literary story, illustrated shore choices, food and visit planning while keeping the research close at hand. The direction is selected; the full implementation remains a local review candidate.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: A

title: One family, different stories
summary: The magazine direction became a shared design system pattern. A lagoon, a stone monument, a sweet and a novelist keep their own story order while sharing typography, colour, navigation and reading rhythm. The agreed checkpoint protects the whole experience before a wider rollout.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: OK, let's go

title: A story should lead somewhere
summary: The magazine direction now connects discovery, a place, an experience, stay-area research and a personal journey. Real browser use exposed long headings, duplicate labels and an overlong ideas list. Those were corrected; native printing remains an explicit unfinished check rather than an assumed pass.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: go

title: A city is also its voices
summary: The visual magazine approach extended from individual places into city guides, languages and literary lives. Bhubaneswar connects stone heritage with the Founder’s 2009 painted-street photographs and a personal journey. The archive keeps its date and uncertainty; a collected memory is not a promise that the same street remains today. Overlapping reviews were gathered into one queue without erasing their history.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: go

title: The useful detail should travel with the story
summary: Bhubaneswar became a fuller reference journey: a gateway, an elephant carved from rock, a local meal and the Founder’s painted-street archive. Practical notes now leave the website with the visitor. Actual downloaded books were inspected; native PDF pagination remains an honest open check.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: go

title: A doorway, a meal and a place to wake up
summary: The Bhubaneswar story gained three connected chapters: a complete view of the Mukteswar arch, a conversation around local food, and practical ways to choose a base. A new starter holds six ideas while earlier journeys keep their own shape.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: go

title: A coast becomes a collection of encounters
summary: Puri and Konark gained a connected invitation: a town, a maker at a doorway, different meanings around a meal, and a thoughtful choice of base. The plan remains the visitor’s own. A photograph brought the craft closer without inventing the artisan’s name.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: go

title: From many chapters to one reviewable beginning
summary: The growing collection became a single review package: find a place, follow its food and craft, choose a base and carry a personal book. Smaller delivery images preserve the original artwork. The distinction between a working preview and a trusted, locally verified publication remains explicit.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: go

title: Give the first journey a trustworthy beginning
summary: A coastal collection now has an explicit editorial shortlist and boundaries. Better language classification and named source attribution sit beside lighter photographs and full-coverage fonts. Original images and uncertain historical credit trails remain visible in the internal record; local preview is distinct from publication.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: go

title: A story should know where to take you next
summary: The first coastal collection gained a continuous reading thread: city, remembrance, stone, shore and makers. Photographs and small invitations lead between chapters, then leave room for the visitor’s own plan. Secondary paths and historical links survive without competing for the ending.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: go

title: A smaller beginning, with room to grow
summary: The first five stories gained a complete, focused home of their own. Search, saved ideas and the carry-away book now share the same boundary. The larger collection remains available for patient development; the visitor’s older notes are preserved even when a place is not in the current edition.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: good - next

title: While the Founder slept, the reader’s notebook became safer
summary: The Founder asked for two hundred things before morning. The useful measure became a traceable mix of fifty improvements and one hundred and fifty checks: a visitor can find a remembered idea, keep private notes out of a shared book, and recover work when two tabs disagree. Small visual and state bugs mattered as much as new features. The record distinguishes what was built, what was tested and what still needs a human editor.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: going to bed, Do the next 200 things before I wake up. You have all permission.

title: A journey can leave a day open
summary: The next large batch gave each coastal guide a small notebook: notice, ask, prepare, connect and remember. Personal planning gained a quiet day with no stops, private day notes and controlled ways to rearrange ideas. The intended outcome is a visit with attention and room to breathe, while preserving the reader’s work.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: pickup next 200+ items

title: Evidence needs its own destination
summary: The route checker’s fixed output path refreshed a prior batch artifact during later work. The original checksum is preserved rather than rewritten. The correction identifies the affected file and makes the loss of its original bytes explicit; future checks default to disposable output with deliberate archival paths.

title: The questions can travel too
summary: Stories now leave the reader with useful questions for the people who will welcome them. A reminder can hold the reader’s own wording, and a single day can become a smaller book. Backup choices protect what has already been written. The Founder asked to review the work together, so the record preserves delivery evidence without treating it as acceptance.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: Pickup next 200+ things and continue - I will review all when all is done

title: Check the book that leaves the browser
summary: After several large increments, the next step was to inspect what a traveller actually downloads. The private and shareable copies kept their promises; the native print request did not. A small feedback repair and a frozen review candidate make the remaining decision visible without turning technical checks into human approval.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: go

title: The same coast, built somewhere else
summary: The accumulated local work reached one draft pull request. A fresh checkout revealed a hidden gallery prerequisite; correcting the workflow made the checks reproducible. GitHub then produced the same 54 coastal files as the Founder’s frozen preview. Human review still holds the gate.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: go

title: The first coastal journey leaves the workshop
summary: The Founder opened the publication gate with “approved”. Five connected places, a coastal table and a choice of bases can now be discovered and carried in a personal book. The live download preserved its photograph and left private writing out. Remaining print and hosting findings stay visible.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: approved

title: A useful story also helps you arrive
summary: After the coastal preview went live, the work record caught up with delivery. The seven guides gained more concrete preparation notes without turning sources into promises about a living place. The portable book now carries the planning references; the unverified print boundary remains explicit.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: go

title: The sources travel with the story
summary: The Founder approved the planning follow-up. Seven practical passages reached the public site, and downloaded books carried their references. Paper choice is now respected; the unresolved native-print and local-verification questions remain in the record.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: approved

title: A question needs somewhere to go
summary: The guides now connect their practical questions to an official starting point. One broken directory link and a contradictory station widget showed why links need inspection, not just collection. The remaining local evidence is named explicitly so future recommendations can earn the reader’s trust.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: go

title: The questions now have a starting point
summary: The Founder approved the official-help update. Seven live guides now connect a visitor’s questions to a relevant directory. The release record distinguishes a successful publication from a download action whose new files could not yet be inspected.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: approved

title: A promise ends at the file
summary: The portable book finally supplied its own evidence: the current guidance and sources were present in real downloads. Older loaded pages explained why a different file could still tell yesterday’s story. The next UI wording makes a modest, accurate promise: the browser was asked to save, and the reader should check the file.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: go

title: The message and the file agree
summary: The Founder approved the small feedback correction. The public journey now tells readers what the browser was asked to do, close to the controls, while real downloaded files prove that current guidance and sources travel with them.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: Approved

title: A draft deserves a kept copy
summary: The download lessons now extend to contributors: asking a browser to save is not evidence that a reader kept the draft. A small acknowledgement preserves that distinction and protects later edits.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: go
HTTPS redirection, why is that not working?

title: A kept copy, and a hosting repair
summary: The Founder approved contribution protection for publication and the custom-domain reset. The live draft now asks for confirmation that a copy was kept. Hosting evidence distinguishes valid DNS and working apex HTTPS from pending certificate issuance and www coverage.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: Approved PR 8, fix the git hub issue permanently

title: One secure address
summary: After the authorised domain reset, GitHub approved a fresh certificate covering both domain variants. Server-side HTTPS enforcement now sends visitors to one secure address, retaining the path and query they followed.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: Approved PR 8, fix the git hub issue permanently

title: The sculpture has another setting
summary: The Konark guide now gives the museum its own place in the reader’s day. Two official sources disagreed on monument hours; the research preserved that uncertainty while finding the official ticket choices. The same context travels in the reader’s book.

source.speaker: Ahimanikya Satapathy
quotes: in the mean time continue with other work
